card.name: Exposed and comparator in trial groups
card.fires_on: The words "exposed" and "comparator" in clinical trial summaries. They describe the group of patients given a drug or the control group they are compared with.

modes.label: exposed
modes.description: The word exposed after a patient count or group, followed by "to" a drug.
modes.example: 4 patients with events out of 3,482<< exposed>> to methylphenidate or amphetamine

modes.label: comparator
modes.description: The word comparator naming the control arm in a trial comparison.
modes.example: DKA was more common in AFREZZA-treated patients (0.43%; n=13) than in<< comparator>>-treated patients (0.14%;
